scope: Post-hoc predictive ablation on the previously evaluated FEM-v2 benchmark; encoded-graph E(3) symmetry only, not a blind benchmark or full raw-layout equivariance claim
source_pin_scope: Reuse references only; this design is not a complete execution-source closure and does not authorize execution of the referenced historical runners

fixed_parameter_matched.hidden_resolution: Analytically choose nearest parameter count to coordinate_update; integer widths 1 through twice the strict hidden width inclusive; ties choose smaller width; resolved width 101 must be recorded in the execution lock

architecture.distance_input: squared Euclidean distance recomputed from current coordinates in both arms
architecture.final_coordinate_branch: omitted because it cannot affect the scalar prediction
architecture.parameter_accounting: report total and prediction-active parameter counts; all retained learned branches must affect prediction
architecture.historical_gnn_role: contextual result only; not a controlled equivariance arm

features.metadata_semantics: width, length, thickness, log conductivity, permittivity, normalized layer, overlap and edge-kind flags are fixed scalar attributes under the encoded-graph group action

normalization.coordinate_scale: max(sqrt(mean squared raw edge-relative Euclidean norm over training edges), 1e-6); one shared isotropic scalar
normalization.edgeless_training_policy: future corpus pipeline must fail closed when the complete training partition contains no edges
normalization.pure_module_edgeless_fallback: for synthetic use only: coordinate scale 1.0, edge mean zero and edge scale 1e-6; this does not bypass the future corpus gate
normalization.edgeless_sample_policy: empty edge features have shape (0,3); scalar messages aggregate to zero
normalization.target_transform: log1p positive reference; train mean and population std with floor; expm1 inverse without clipping

optimization.model_selection: fixed final epoch; validation is diagnostic only

initialization.same_width_common_state: copy every matching non-coordinate tensor from the initialized fixed_same_width reference into coordinate_update; hash and verify identical shared initial tensors
initialization.parameter_matched_state: separate model initialized after resetting the same cell initialization seed; shape mismatch precludes tensor-wise pairing
initialization.batch_order: fresh numpy default_rng(initialization_seed) for each arm, shuffling the identical canonical training-ID order each epoch

evaluation.primary_metric: per-target family-macro MAPE percent on frozen test families
evaluation.paired_difference: coordinate_update minus fixed control family-macro MAPE, percentage points; positive favors the fixed control
evaluation.aggregate: mean over all 25 cells; retain per-cell metrics and paired differences

resampling.semantics: descriptive crossed-axis seed-grid sensitivity interval, not a population confidence interval

evaluation.r4: excluded; no R4 target or evaluation claim

lifecycle.training_namespace: selected split train and validation table plus task-private output only; no test, R4, other split, other task checkpoint or previous finalizer bytes
lifecycle.symmetry_gate: freeze transform set and numeric tolerance before execution; check encoded-graph rotation, reflection, translation and permutation including raw-coordinate normalization path
lifecycle.failed_attempts: preserve all evidence; no result-selected retry or silent protocol modification
